_source: Generated from the official CEC2020 competition implementation cec20_func.m / Cal_par.m (Kumar et al. 2020), obtained from https://github.com/P-N-Suganthan/2020-RW-Constrained-Optimisation. The MATLAB expressions were mechanically translated to numpy and evaluated at the sample points below. These are reference values for a differential test of the hand-written transcriptions in nelder_mead/benchmarks/cec2020_rw.py, NOT values produced by that module.
